summary: Master Power BI for business reporting and dashboards. Join our comprehensive training to unlock the full potential of your data visualization skills.
lede: Power BI for Business Reporting and Dashboards teaches you to turn raw data into meaningful dashboards and reports that support faster, more informed decisions. You will learn to connect diverse data sources, clean and transform data, and create intuitive visuals that communicate insights clearly. The course also covers automated reporting and publishing insights for immediate use by your team. With practical, hands-on learning, you can build dynamic dashboards that help stakeholders track performance, identify trends, and act with greater clarity and confidence.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across various sectors who are responsible for making sense of data and generating actionable reports. Whether you're in the public sector, a private enterprise, or an NGO, this course is for you.
modules: Introduction to Power BI and Business Reporting
Data Cleaning and Transformation Using Power Query
Introduction to DAX for Calculation and Analysis
Power BI for Business Decision Making
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of data concepts and familiarity with Excel. No prior experience with Power BI is required.
